Featured in Development

  • Adopting Memory-Safety and Fine-Grained Compartmentalisation with CHERI

    David Chisnall discusses how the CHERI hardware architecture redefines pointer safety to solve isolation and sharing challenges. He explains how CHERI enables spatial and temporal memory safety for C/C++, scales down to microcontrollers with CHERIoT, and replaces costly OS-level RPC mechanisms with lightweight, auditable compartmentalization - all without requiring massive codebase rewrites.

Online InfoQ AI Security & Privacy Engineering Certification (Aug 26): Shipping AI in a regulated environment? InfoQ 在线 AI 安全与隐私工程认证（8月26日）：如何在监管环境下交付 AI 系统？

Architecture as a Socio-Technical Craft 架构：一门社会技术工艺

Aug 21, 2026

by

  • InfoQ

    ACCELERATING THE SOFTWARE SIDE OF HUMAN PROGRESS

reviewed by

  • Luca Mezzalira

    Principal Serverless Specialist Solutions Architect @AWS

The InfoQ Newsletter

A round-up of last week’s content on InfoQ sent out every Tuesday. Join a community of over 250,000 senior developers. View an example

We protect your privacy.

  • Reading list

We have a habit of talking about architecture as something you get right, as though the whole thing comes down to a handful of decisions you make once and are then judged on: you draw the boundaries, you ship, and the work is graded on whether the design was sound. The trouble with that framing is that it quietly assumes the target holds still, and it never does, because regulation shifts, competitors move, and some new technology comes along and resets what good even looks like almost as soon as you've settled on it. Fitness, in other words, is a moving target rather than a fixed property, which is really just a formal way of saying that a system you designed well two years ago can quietly stop fitting today without anyone having made a single bad call along the way. Evolution isn't the exception you scramble to deal with when things go sideways; it's the normal state of affairs, and the sooner we design for it, the easier our lives become.世人常觉架构之术，在于一朝定乾坤。仿佛只要做对了几项决策，画好了界限，交付了系统，便可由人评判优劣。殊不知此念大谬，盖因世事如棋，局势瞬息万变。监管政策更迭、竞品步步紧逼、新技术层出不穷，往日之良方，今日未必合用。所谓“适宜”，并非一成不变的死物，而是一个动态演进的过程。昔日设计的精妙系统，即便无人犯错，时过境迁亦可能不再合拍。演进并非系统崩坏时的救急之策，而是常态。越早以此为基准进行设计，日后便越是从容。

That's the thread across the seven articles ahead of you. They come at evolutionary architecture from genuinely different angles - from AI context stores and gateways through to team topologies, boundary drift, and platform convergence sequences - and yet they all share one conviction: that architecture is a living, sociotechnical craft, and that the teams who really thrive are the ones treating friction, fitness, and flow as things to be sensed and shaped on purpose, rather than left to chance.此后七篇文章，皆以此为脉络。诸位作者从 AI 上下文存储、网关架构，谈及团队拓扑、边界漂移与平台融合，角度虽异，却皆持同一信念：架构乃是活的社会技术工艺。真正的高手，从不将摩擦、适宜性与流程交付于机缘，而是主动感知、悉心雕琢。

Free download免费下载

The InfoQ Architecture as a Socio-Technical Craft eMag includes:InfoQ《架构：一门社会技术工艺》电子杂志内容包括：

The articles in this eMag were written by participants of the online InfoQ Certified Architect Program. They represent the capstone of their work, reflecting the cohort's collective learnings on the intersection of AI and modern software architecture.本刊文章皆出自 InfoQ 认证架构师项目学员之手。此乃他们学业之结晶，凝聚了众人对于 AI 与现代软件架构交融之道的集体智慧。

  • Comprehension at AI Speed: Building a Context Store for Evolutionary Architecture by Stella Berhe, Stephan Bragner, Vikram Maran, Anand Jayaraman
    AI makes the first 80% of development feel fast, but hides architectural complexity until it's too late. To prevent system instability, engineering leaders must shift from raw throughput to systemic comprehension. By unifying spec-anchored SDD, TDD, and automated fitness functions into a repo-bound "Context Store," teams can ensure AI agents and human reviewers evolve code safely.
         AI 时代的认知之道：构建演进式架构的上下文存储 —— Stella Berhe, Stephan Bragner, Vikram Maran, Anand Jayaraman。AI 虽能助开发一日千里，却也掩盖了架构之复杂。为防系统动荡，工程领袖当从追求吞吐量，转向追求系统认知。通过将规范锚定的 SDD、TDD 与自动化适宜性函数统一于“上下文存储”之中，方能确保 AI 智能体与人类评审者在代码演进中稳如泰山。
  • An Evolutionary Architecture Pattern for Managing AI’s Pace of Change by Joe Price, Branimir Đurek, Pavlos Migkiros, Trevor Dearham
    Traditional API gateways assume deterministic services and simple schemas - assumptions agentic AI breaks. Discover why enterprise engineering leaders are adopting AI Gateways as an evolutionary architecture seam. Centralize guardrails, model routing, agent identity, action policy, and semantic audit within a single control plane to prevent costly incidents while keeping core platforms stable.
         应对 AI 变革的演进式架构模式 —— Joe Price, Branimir Đurek, Pavlos Migkiros, Trevor Dearham。传统 API 网关多基于确定性服务，难以应对智能体 AI 的变数。企业工程领袖正将 AI 网关视为演进式架构的枢纽。通过在统一控制平面内集中管理防护栏、模型路由、智能体身份及策略，既能化解成本高昂的事故，又能稳固核心平台。
  • Enabling Evolutionary Architecture Through the Preservation of Change Locality by Michael Fischer, Nicholas Lawrence, Monica Karekar
    Why do simple features suddenly require cross-team negotiations? In this article, explore how boundary drift quietly destroys change locality and increases cognitive load across teams. Learn practical sociotechnical strategies - redistributing mechanics, exposing essential policy, and rehearsing exception paths - to restore domain boundaries and enable a truly evolutionary software architecture.
         通过保持变更局部性实现演进式架构 —— Michael Fischer, Nicholas Lawrence, Monica Karekar。为何简单功能竟需跨团队反复拉锯？本文探讨了边界漂移如何悄然破坏变更局部性，加重团队认知负担。通过重新分配机制、暴露核心策略及演练异常路径，重塑领域边界，方能实现真正的演进式软件架构。
  • The Architectural Decay Loop: Fitness Functions as Guardrails by Nicola Aretini, Amita Iyer, Narendra Paladugu, Andreas Schlapbach
    AI acceleration boosts delivery speed, but without guardrails, architectural drift quietly compounds into costly technical debt. The Architectural Decay Loop shows how systems erode and why one-off fixes fail. By embedding fitness functions into CI/CD pipelines, engineering leaders can enforce boundary integrity and cross-functional requirements automatically - shifting feedback from production outages to build-time checks.
         架构衰变循环：以适宜性函数为防护栏 —— Nicola Aretini, Amita Iyer, Narendra Paladugu, Andreas Schlapbach。AI 加速了交付，却若无防护，架构漂移将化作沉重的技术债。本文揭示了系统如何陷入衰变循环，并论证了为何零散修复终难奏效。将适宜性函数植入 CI/CD 流水线，变生产环境的“救火”为构建阶段的“防患于未然”。
  • Evolutionary Architecture Starts with Team Structure: Three Tiers from Topology to Daily Practice by Teymur Bayramov, Jake Brinkmann, Kyle Hibbert, James Owens
    Software systems stall not from bad code, but unaligned team structures. This article presents a 3-tier framework for evolutionary architecture: Stream-aligned topologies (Watershed), decentralized guardrails & internal platforms (Forest), and daily pruning practices like TDD & refactoring (Bonsai). Learn how socio-technical alignment empowers teams to absorb entropy and deliver fast flow.    演进式架构始于团队结构：从拓扑到日常实践的三层框架 —— Teymur Bayramov, Jake Brinkmann, Kyle Hibbert, James Owens。系统停滞，非代码之过，实乃团队结构失调。本文提出三层框架：流式对齐拓扑（流域）、去中心化防护栏与内部平台（森林），以及 TDD 与重构等日常修剪（盆景）。唯有社会技术对齐，方能消解熵增，实现高效流动。

  • Platform Convergence: Why the Sequence of Decisions Matters More Than the Merge Itself by Jimmy Kurian, Anusha Sharma, Marta Beznos, Dinesh Ramadoss, Joe McBride
    Platform convergence is rarely a simple merge; it is a sequence of strategic decisions driven by organizational incentives. This article explores four recurring patterns for platform consolidation, emphasizing Minimal Viable Integration, ownership of integration seams, and why partial federation is often a permanent operating model rather than an incomplete migration project.    平台融合：决策顺序重于合并本身 —— Jimmy Kurian, Anusha Sharma, Marta Beznos, Dinesh Ramadoss, Joe McBride。平台融合非简单合并，实为组织激励驱动下的战略抉择。本文剖析了四种平台整合模式，强调最小可行性集成与集成边界的所有权，揭示了为何部分联合往往是长久的运营模式，而非未竟的迁移项目。

  • Evolutionary Architecture in Practice: Sensing, Quantifying, and Acting on Socio-Technical Friction by Giorgio Polvara, Gerhard van Deventer, Jos Huiting, Sebastian Ivan
    Software architecture is a socio-technical system that decays as context shifts. This article presents a framework for sensing, quantifying, and acting on socio-technical friction before it halts software delivery. Learn how to identify true constraints, automate leading indicators through fitness functions in CI/CD, and leverage AI as an evolutionary accelerator rather than an entropy engine.    演进式架构实践：感知、量化并应对社会技术摩擦 —— Giorgio Polvara, Gerhard van Deventer, Jos Huiting, Sebastian Ivan。软件架构乃社会技术系统，随环境变迁而衰变。本文提供了一套感知与应对摩擦的框架，助你在其阻碍交付前将其化解。学会识别真实约束，通过 CI/CD 中的适宜性函数实现指标自动化，让 AI 成为演进的加速器，而非熵增的引擎。

Thank you for reading!  And, as always, please send any feedback to us at editors@infoq.com or on LinkedIn, Bluesky or X.感谢阅读！如有高见，欢迎致信 editors@infoq.com，或通过 LinkedIn、Bluesky、X 与我们交流。
